integrity: The general result follows from an explicit three-subcomplex decomposition and dominated-vertex collapses; the integral group action follows from Mayer–Vietoris naturality and simplicial contiguity. The attached Python checks are finite and independently reproducible. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
limitations: The theorem treats the two-independence complex of crown graphs for every integer \(n\ge3\), not arbitrary higher-independence parameters. It does not prove equivariant homotopy equivalence or publication priority. The finite program is corroboration, not the infinite proof.
title: Crown-graph two-independence homotopy and integral symmetry
